rationale: Span s3 identifies frozen answer David Motl as Acting Director only through 2018-01-31. Spans s1–s2 establish the audit-time (2026-07-21) incumbent as Paul Hollis (confirmed 2025-12-18, in office since 2026-01-05). Motl therefore ceased to be current long before the audit date; the office has been revised through later appointments including Ryder (s4) and Hollis.
